description: Add new observations to existing entities in the knowledge graph. Content the entity already holds is not added again, while duplicates within one request are kept as separate occurrences; the response reports what was added per entity. Every named entity must exist — a missing one fails the whole call, so create it with create_entities first. To replace a content use update_observations, to remove one use delete_observations.

observations.description: One entry per entity: the entity name and the contents to add

contents.description: An array of observation contents to add

entityName.description: The name of the entity to add the observations to

name: add_observations
title: Add Observations
